title: Armada Hoffler Announces Quarterly Dividend
description: Armada Hoffler Properties (NYSE:AHH) announced that its Board of Directors declared a cash dividend of $0.205 per common share for the third quarter, payable on October 3, 2024, to stockholders of record on September 25, 2024. The Board also declared a cash dividend of $0.421875 per share on its 6.75% Series A Cumulative Redeemable Perpetual Preferred Stock, payable on October 15, 2024, to stockholders of record on October 1, 2024.

title: Armada Hoffler Announces Upsizing and Pricing of Public Offering of Common Stock
description: Armada Hoffler, a real estate investment trust, has priced a public offering of 9 million shares of its common stock, raising approximately $94.5 million. The company plans to use the net proceeds to repay certain loans and amounts outstanding under its revolving credit facility.

title: Armada Hoffler Announces Quarterly Dividend
description: Armada Hoffler Properties (NYSE:AHH) announced a quarterly cash dividend of $0.205 per common share, payable on January 2, 2025, to stockholders of record on December 26, 2024. The company also declared a cash dividend of $0.421875 per share on its 6.75% Series A Cumulative Redeemable Perpetual Preferred Stock, payable on January 15, 2025, to stockholders of record on December 31, 2024.

title: Armada Hoffler Correction to Record Date for Preferred Stock Quarterly Dividend
description: Armada Hoffler announced a correction to the record date for the cash dividend on its 6.75% Series A Cumulative Redeemable Perpetual Preferred Stock. The record date has been changed from December 31, 2024 to January 2, 2025, while the payment date and dividend amount remain unchanged.
